name: Research fan-out
description: Take a topic, research it down two branches at once — a fresh web search AND your local document library — then merge both and write a one-page brief. Shows: forked branches (two plain edges out of one node), the merge join, workflow input, search_docs (local RAG).

nodes.text:
Write a one-page research brief on “{{input}}”, in Markdown.
You have two sources above: a fresh web search ({{node.2}}) and my local document library ({{node.3}}).
Structure: 3-sentence summary · what's new · what my own documents add or contradict · 3 open questions. Cite which source each point came from.
